_comment: JSON doesn't support real comments, so read this as a normal (unused) key. Copy this file to item_values.json and fill in real itemIds once you've run build_data.py once — it'll write data/meta.json with the full items list (itemId -> name) so you can look up which id is which material. A rough starting scale: LMD/basic mats ~1, common crafting mats ~3-5, advanced mats ~8-15, elite/top-tier mats ~20-40. Tune these however you like later; they only affect the 'stage value' ranking, not the raw drop rates.
